gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histopathologically proven diagnosis of relapsed/refractory high-grade glioma (HGG) including glioblastoma or variants (gliosarcoma, giant cell glioblastoma etc), World Health Organization (WHO) grade IV, or anaplastic astrocytoma, or anaplastic oligodendroglioma, WHO grade III.

candidate_evidence.quote: Phase I Dose Escalation Study on Bicalutamide, an Androgen Receptor Antagonist, as a Radiosensitizer Combining With Brain Re-irradiation to Treat Recurrent/Progressive Glioblastoma/High Grade Glioma

role_evidence.quote: Participants will take oral bicalutamide daily for six (6) months at a starting dose of 150 mg daily.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Bicalutamide, an Androgen Receptor Antagonist, as a Radiosensitizer

coder_notes: Recurrent high-grade glioma (grade III-IV) including glioblastoma, named in conditions and inclusion. Historical terminology (WHO grade IV, anaplastic astrocytoma, no IDH requirement). Single arm: bicalutamide plus re-irradiation (35 Gy/10 fx), so regimen combination with radiotherapy. Androgen receptor status is not mentioned as a biomarker.
